blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce PLANTEUR, a benchmark for crop-type mapping from satellite images in the French overseas territories. Building on the PASTIS design, PLANTEUR provides georeferenced and aligned Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat-8 sequences with parcel-derived labels spanning six tropical regions and an 8-class label space. We define both a standard test split and a leave-one-island-out protocol to measure cross-territory generalization, and evaluate fully supervised models, linear probes, and fine-tuned foundation models. The benchmark code and data are open source and available on GitHub and Hugging Face.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了PANTEUR,这是从法国海外领土卫星图像中绘制作物类型的地图的基准。 在PASTIS设计的基础上,PLANTEUR提供了地理参照和对齐的Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1和Landsat-8序列,并附有覆盖六个热带区域的包裹标签和一个8级标签空间。 我们既定义了标准测试分解,又定义了离岛协议,以衡量跨领土的概括,并评价了完全监督的模型,线性探测器,以及微调的基础模型. 基准代码和数据是开源的,可在GitHub和Hugging Face上查阅.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Foundation models and open data are driving rapid progress in machine learning for remote sensing [ 7 , 8 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Benchmarks play a key role in tracking how model improvements carry over to real applications. Good benchmarks have: high-quality labels, associated geospatial metadata (so users can fetch additional modalities/time series), and high correlation with real-world tasks. PASTIS [ 7 ] is one of the field’s most trusted benchmarks because it pairs dense, high-quality parcel labels with complete geospatial metadata — but its coverage is limited to metropolitan France. Agricultural systems where mapping could be most valuable — smallholder, tropical, topographically complex — are almost entirely absent from evaluation. We extend PASTIS to six tropical regions to fill this gap.
blocks.zh: 基础模型和开放数据正在推动遥感机器学习方面的快速进展[7、8、10、11、12]。 基准在跟踪模型改进如何延续到实际应用方面发挥关键作用。 良好的基准包括:高质量的标签、相关的地理空间元数据(用户可以获取额外的模式/时间序列),以及与现实世界任务的高度相关性。 PASTIS [7] 是这个领域最值得信赖的基准之一,因为它将密集而高品质的包裹标签与完整的地理空间元数据相配——但其覆盖范围仅限于法国本土. 评价中几乎完全没有测绘最有价值的农业系统——小农、热带和地形复杂。 我们把PASTIS扩展到六个热带地区,以填补这一空白。

blocks.en: We present PLANTEUR, a new open-access crop-type segmentation benchmark. PLANTEUR complements the existing PASTIS benchmark by expanding the geographic diversity to tropical regions, while maintaining high quality labels. We use France’s Land Parcel Identification System data source for crop type labels spanning six tropical regions, and align corresponding Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat-8 time series.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Planteur,一个新的开放性作物类型分块基准。 PANTEUR通过将地理多样性扩大到热带地区,同时保持高品质的标签来补充现有的PASTIS基准. 我们使用法国的Land Parcel识别系统数据源,用于覆盖6个热带区域的作物类型标签,并调整相应的Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1和Landsat-8时间序列。

blocks.en: We evaluate twelve models across linear probing, fine-tuning and supervised training, on a standard split and leave-one-island-out setup, as well as with varying inputs and hyperparameters. We find that all methods we evaluated exhibit substantially lower performance on PLANTEUR compared to PASTIS. This validates our motivation for developing PLANTEUR and provides a new challenge for the modeling community to tackle.
blocks.zh: 我们通过线性测试、微调和监督培训,对12个模型进行评价,这些模型涉及标准的分拆和一岛出岛设置,以及不同的投入和超参数。 我们发现,我们评价的所有方法都显示,与PASTIS相比,PANTEUR公司的业绩要低得多。 这证实了我们开发PANTEUR的动机,并为建模界提供了需要应对的新挑战.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of region transfer, we experiment with training on PASTIS samples in addition to PLANTEUR samples and find that those added samples, though different from the distribution of the PLANTEUR test set, improve performance for several models. We explore performance on unseen regions by proposing a leave-one-island-out split and see a major drop in performance for most methods, suggesting a gap between a model performing well on a benchmark and generalizing to real-world tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了评估区域转移的影响,我们除了PANTEUR样本外,还试验了PATIS样本的培训,并发现这些添加的样本虽然不同于PANTEUR测试集的分布,但能提高若干模型的性能. 我们探索了未见区域的业绩,提出 " 一岛分治 " ,看到大多数方法的绩效显著下降,表明在基准方面业绩良好的模式与将任务概括到现实世界之间存在差距。

blocks.en: Our contributions include 1) a dataset with permissive licenses including imagery from three sensor types, 2) geographically balanced splits, including a leave-one-island-out setup, and 3) extensive results on a variety of baseline methods, showing significant room for improvement. In Section 2 we introduce the construction and breakdown of PLANTEUR. In Section 3 we present the experimental results on PLANTEUR across a wide range of setups.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献包括:(1) 一套具有许可许可证的数据集,包括来自三种传感器类型的图像;(2) 地理平衡的分割,包括一个离岛设置;和(3) 各种基线方法的广泛结果,显示出重大的改进余地。 在第二节中,我们介绍Planteur的建造和分解情况。 在第3节中,我们介绍了关于PANTEUR的实验结果,涉及广泛的结构。

blocks.en: 2 PLANTEUR: Crop-Type Segmentation in France’s Overseas Territories
blocks.zh: 2 PLANTEUR:法国海外领土的作物分类

blocks.en: PLANTEUR is an open-access satellite image time series (SITS) semantic segmentation benchmark for crop type mapping. This dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/planteur-benchmark .
blocks.zh: PANTEUR是用于作物类型绘图的可开放存取的卫星图像时间序列语义分区基准。 该数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/planteur-benchmark上公开查阅。

blocks.en: 2.1 Background: PASTIS
blocks.zh: 2.1 背景情况: 统计

blocks.en: PASTIS [ 7 ] comprises 2,433 multi-spectral image sequences with both semantic and instance annotations. Each sequence covers a 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixel patch at 10m resolution, with between 38 and 61 Sentinel-2 acquisitions taken over a one-year period, for a total of over 2 billion annotated pixels spanning more than 4,000 km 2 across four regions of metropolitan France. This benchmark demonstrated that parcel-based crop-type segmentation from Sentinel-2 time series can be benchmarked with high label fidelity, leveraging France’s Land Parcel Identification System, which claims a relative error rate in terms of surfaces under 0.3% [ 7 ] ; this is because the parcel boundary and crop type data comes directly from farmers, and there are financial penalties and random audits that incentivize very accurate reporting. PASTIS is a reliable and trustworthy benchmark, but it is geographically limited to France, a single country in Europe. Fortunately, the same high quality data exists for other French regions. PLANTEUR extends this design to France’s overseas territories, preserving the same annotation provenance while adding geographic and agronomic diversity through tropical crop regimes that are absent or underrepresented in metropolitan France, which we hope will be a useful complement to PASTIS.
blocks.zh: PASTIS [7]由2,433个多光谱图像序列组成,同时有语义和实例说明. 每个序列覆盖了128×128128\times 128像素补丁,分辨率为10m,38至61 Sentinel-2的收购占用了一年的时间,总共超过20亿个附加说明的像素跨越了法国大都会四个地区的4000多公里2. 这一基准表明,Sentinel-2时间序列的以地块为主的作物类型分块可以以高标签的忠诚度作为基准,利用法国的Land Parcel识别系统(Land Parcel Information System),该系统声称地表的相对误差率低于0.3% [7];这是因为地块边界和作物类型数据直接出自农民,并且有罚款和随机审计激励非常准确的报告. PASTIS是一个可靠和可信赖的基准,但它在地理上仅限于法国这个欧洲单一的国家. 所幸的是,法国其他地区也有同样高质量的数据。 PANTEUR将这一设计推广到法国的海外领土,保留同样的注释来源,同时通过在法国本土不存在或代表性不足的热带作物制度增加地理和农业多样性,我们希望这将成为PASTIS的有益补充。

blocks.en: 2.2 Description
blocks.zh: 2.2 说明

blocks.en: We aim to follow the setup of PASTIS for ease of adoption. PLANTEUR consists of 2,750 multi-spectral sequences, spanning September 2018 to December 2019. Each Sentinel-2 L2A series has shape T × 10 × 128 × 128 T\times 10\times 128\times 128 and each Sentinel-1 RTC series T × 2 × 128 × 128 T\times 2\times 128\times 128 , with T T between 40 and 150 observations (median 87 and 123 respectively; series are required to have at least 40 and are capped at 150). Landsat-8 is provided at T × 10 × 64 × 64 T\times 10\times 64\times 64 with a co-registered panchromatic band at T × 1 × 128 × 128 T\times 1\times 128\times 128 , where T T ranges from 28 to 61 (median 30), reflecting its 16-day revisit. Like PASTIS-R [ 6 ] , we added additional sensor modalities to encourage multi-modal experiments, and extended the time range to make it easier to run with recent embedding products. The dataset spans 4,506 km 2 across Réunion, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, Mayotte, and Saint-Martin, geographically visualized in Figure 1 .

blocks.en: 2.3 Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.3 注释

blocks.en: Each pixel of PLANTEUR is labeled as one of the 7 7 crop classes or a Background, non-crop, class. The benchmark label space contains the following crop classes: Meadow, Fruit/Vegetable/Flower, Orchard, Sugarcane, Banana, Pineapple, Tropical tuber. The original label space contains additional crop types; we map any class with fewer than 40k labeled pixels to void . Void pixels are masked out of the training loss and excluded from evaluation metrics.

blocks.en: 2.4 Splits
blocks.zh: 2.4 拆分数

blocks.en: Splits are assigned to spatial blocks, not to individual windows. Each 128 × 128 128\times 128 window is mapped to the 0.1 ∘ 0.1^{\circ} ( ≈ 11 \approx 11 km) latitude/longitude cell containing its centroid, and the split is assigned to the cell, so every window in a neighborhood lands in the same partition. This is necessary because the windows are densely tiled: adjacent windows observe the same landscape and crop calendar, and frequently the same parcels straddling a window boundary. Within a territory, we greedily select cells based on a hash-derived order, and assign them cumulatively until 70%, 85% and 100% of that territory’s windows are covered. The 70/15/15 allocation is applied independently per territory, so every territory except Saint-Martin appears in all three partitions. This yields 1,896 train / 411 validation / 443 test windows (68.9% / 14.9% / 16.1%); the 443-window test partition is used for all in-domain evaluation.
blocks.zh: 分块被分配到空间块,而不是单个窗口. 每个128×128\times 128窗口被映射到0.1 QQ 0.1+Circ} (XQ 11\\约11km) 含有其中间体的纬度/经度细胞,分出被分配到细胞中,所以附近每个窗口都在同一分区中着陆. 这样做是必要的,因为窗户被密集地打砖:相邻的窗户遵守同样的地貌和收成日历,而且常常是同一块地块跨越了窗户边界. 在一块土地上,我们贪婪地选择基于散列顺序的细胞,并累计分配到70%、85%和100%的窗口覆盖。 70/15/15的拨款按每个领土独立实施,因此除圣马丁以外的每一个领土都出现在所有三个分区中. 这样可产生1,896列列车/411次验证/443个测试窗口(68.9%/14.9%/16.1%);443-窗口测试分区用于所有域内评价.

All territories except Mayotte have train / validation / test ratios similar to the global ratio. Mayotte is relatively small, yielding a substantial deviation (39% train, 15% validation, 46% test). Saint-Martin is very small, so it just goes in the train set. We prioritize the spatial-block constraint over a closer ratio, because leakage would be a larger issue. blocks.en: 3 Experiments & Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 模式

blocks.en: We benchmark three method families on PLANTEUR, spanning supervised models that performed well on PASTIS [ 7 , 5 ] , linear probes – released embedding products [ 4 , 3 , 2 ] and frozen encoders of remote sensing foundation models [ 17 , 1 , 13 , 14 , 16 ] , and fine-tuned foundation models [ 15 , 17 , 1 , 13 , 14 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们以PLANTEUR为基准衡量三种方法家族,它们跨越了在PASTIS[7,5]上表现良好的监督模型,线性探测器——释放出嵌入产品[4,3,2]并冻结了遥感基础模型的编码器[17, 1, 13, 14, 16],以及微调的基础模型[15, 17, 1, 13, 14, 4].

blocks.en: Baselines are trained on the PLANTEUR training split with no pretraining, using the code released for these models. • U-TAE [ 7 ] : U-TAE is a deep learning architecture, originally proposed alongside PASTIS, that combines 2D convolutional layers with a temporal self-attention mechanism to perform highly accurate, date-agnostic spatio-temporal segmentation on satellite image time series datasets. We use the original PASTIS recipe (1.08M parameters, Adam 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch 4, 100 epochs) for experiments on PLANTEUR. • TSViT [ 5 ] : TSViT is a fully-attentional, transformer-based architecture, that was a prominent baseline model for PASTIS. The model operates on 24 × 24 24\times 24 tiles with 12-step sequences. We use the original PASTIS recipe (1.66M parameters, AdamW 10 − 3 10^{-3} with a cosine schedule and 10 warm-up epochs, batch 16, 100 epochs) for experiments on PLANTEUR.
blocks.zh: 利用为这些模式发布的代码,对基线进行了关于 " PANTEUR " 培训的培训,未进行预训。 ^ U-TAE [7]:U-TAE是一种深层学习架构,最初与PASTIS并列而来,将2D分层与时间自留机制相结合,在卫星图像时间序列数据集上进行高度准确,日期不可知的分层. 我们使用原始的PATIS配方(1.08M参数,Adam 10 − 3 10^{-3} 第4批,100个纪元)在Planteur进行实验. • TSVIT [5]: TSViT是一个全心全意,以变压器为基础的建筑,是PASTIS的显著基准模型. 该型号以24×24相24相24相24相24相的有12步序列的瓷砖来运行. 我们使用原始的PATIS配方(1.66M参数, AdamW 10 - 3 10 Q-3 }),带有同位素表和10个暖化纪元, 第16批, 第100个纪元)用于Planteur的实验.

blocks.en: U-TAE [ 7 ] : U-TAE is a deep learning architecture, originally proposed alongside PASTIS, that combines 2D convolutional layers with a temporal self-attention mechanism to perform highly accurate, date-agnostic spatio-temporal segmentation on satellite image time series datasets. We use the original PASTIS recipe (1.08M parameters, Adam 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch 4, 100 epochs) for experiments on PLANTEUR.
blocks.zh: U-TAE [7]:U-TAE是一款深层的学习架构,最初与PASTIS并列而来,将2D分层与时间自留机制相结合,在卫星图像时间序列数据集上进行高度准确,日期不可知的斯皮提奥-时相分. 我们使用原始的PATIS配方(1.08M参数,Adam 10 − 3 10 ^{-3 } 第4批,100个纪元)在Planteur进行实验.

blocks.en: TSViT [ 5 ] : TSViT is a fully-attentional, transformer-based architecture, that was a prominent baseline model for PASTIS. The model operates on 24 × 24 24\times 24 tiles with 12-step sequences. We use the original PASTIS recipe (1.66M parameters, AdamW 10 − 3 10^{-3} with a cosine schedule and 10 warm-up epochs, batch 16, 100 epochs) for experiments on PLANTEUR.

blocks.en: We evaluate two linear-probe setups. • Released embeddings. For released annual embedding products, we fit a linear head on the precomputed embeddings: 50 epochs, one embedding per pixel ( patch size = 1 \text{patch size}=1 ) over a 16 × 16 16\times 16 window. The probe learning rate is selected from an 8-point sweep ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 0.5 0.5 ) on the validation set. At most, the learning rate affects mIoU by 2.3 points. – AEF [ 2 ] . AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) is Google DeepMind’s pixel-wise embedding model that distills multi-sensor satellite observations into 64-dimensional annual embeddings at 10m resolution. We use their supplied embeddings, read from precomputed rasters. – Tessera v1 [ 4 ] . Tessera v1 is a dual-encoder model over Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1. We use the released precomputed 128-dimensional embeddings. – Tessera v1.1 [ 4 ] . Tessera v1.1 embeddings improve upon v1 with fewer tiling artifacts, better temporal stability, and a wider encoder. We use the released precomputed 128-dimensional embeddings. • Frozen encoders. Across all models we fit a linear head on features from a frozen encoder, which is never updated: 50 epochs, mean pooling, a 16 × 16 16\times 16 window, and a per-pixel readout obtained by bilinearly upsampling each encoder’s token grid to the label resolution. The probe learning rate is selected per model from the same 8-point sweep ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 0.5 0.5 ). Patch size follows each model’s native setting and is stated per model below. – AnySat [ 1 ] . AnySat is a multi-modal JEPA-style encoder that takes in various combinations of sensors and spatial resolutions through a scale-aware patch embedding. We use a patch size of 4, window size of 16, and input up to 96 Sentinel-2 observations in 2019. – Galileo [ 14 ] . Galileo is a multi-modal masked-autoencoder trained with paired global and local objectives over stacked modalities. We use a patch size of 4, window size of 16, and input 12 Sentinel-2 monthly mosaics from 2019. – Presto [ 13 ] . Presto is a lightweight transformer pretrained on pixel time series, encoding each pixel’s temporal sequence independently. We use a patch size of 1, window size of 16, and input 12 Sentinel-2 monthly mosaics from 2019. – Tessera v2 [ 3 ] . Tessera v2 is a pixel-wise Earth foundation model producing 128-dimensional annual embeddings for 2019 at 10m. Since there are no released precomputed embeddings, we run the released v2 inference code to generate embeddings using all Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 observations in 2019, and keep the encoder frozen. – Copernicus-FM [ 17 ] . Copernicus-FM is a ViT that is sensor-agnostic across spectral inputs. We resize tiles to 224 × 224 224\times 224 with bilinear interpolation to match the native pretraining setup; with patch size 16 and window size 128 this yields a 14 × 14 14\times 14 token grid per tile. It is a single-image encoder with no temporal axis so we encode each of the 12 monthly mosaics for 2019 independently and mean-pool the results. – OlmoEarth v1.3 [ 16 ] . OlmoEarth v1.3 is the OlmoEarth model specifically built for embeddings. It is a d = 768 d{=}768 encoder with a distilled linear student, and we read it out three ways — through the distilled 64-dimensional and 128-dimensional projections, and at full register width with no projection — reported as separate rows throughout. We use a patch size of 1, window size of 16, and 12 monthly mosaics for 2019 as input.

AlphaEarth Foundations(AEF)是Google DeepMind基于像素的嵌入模型,以10m分辨率将多传感器卫星观测分解成64维年嵌入. 我们使用它们提供的嵌入, 从预计算光栅读取。 - 泰塞拉v1 [4] (英语). Tessera v1是双编码器模型,凌驾于哨兵-2和哨兵-1之上. 我们使用释放的预计算出128维嵌入. - 泰塞拉v1.1 [4] (英语). Tessera v1.1 嵌入式在v1上得到改进,平板化的文物较少,时间稳定性较好,编码器范围也更广. 我们使用释放的预计算出128维嵌入. • 冻结编码器。 在所有的模型中,我们用一个线性头来检查一个被冻结的编码器的特性,它从未更新过:50个纪元,表示集合,一个16×16 16\times 16窗口,以及每个编码器的符号网格通过双线性地取自标签分辨率的每个像素读取。 探测器的学习率是从同一个8分扫描(10 - 4 10 - 4)到0.5 (0.5)的每个模型中选择的. 补丁大小遵循每个模型的原生设置,并在下面每个模型中注明。 - AnySat [1] (美国英语). AnySat是一个多式JEPA风格的编码器,通过有尺度意识的补丁嵌入,在各种传感器和空间分辨率的组合中进行. 使用4个补丁大小,窗口大小为16个,2019年输入可达96个哨兵-2观测. -伽利略[14]。 伽利略是一个多模式的蒙面自动编码器,经过培训,其全球和地方目标均与堆叠模式相匹配。 使用补丁尺寸为4个,窗口尺寸为16个,输入为12 Sentinel-2 从2019年开始的每月镶嵌. ——普雷斯托 [13] (英语). Presto是一个在像素时间序列上预先训练的轻量级变压器,独立地编码了每个像素的时间序列. 使用补丁尺寸为1个,窗口尺寸为16个,输入12 Sentinel-2 从2019年开始的每月镶嵌. - 泰塞拉v2 [3]. Tessera v2是一款以像素为精度的地基模型,为2019年生产了128维年嵌入量为10m. 由于没有发布预计算嵌入物,我们运行已发布 v2 推论代码,以利用2019年所有的Sentinel-2和Sentinel-1观测结果生成嵌入物,并保持编码器被冻结. – 哥白尼-FM [17] (英语). 哥白尼-FM是一种跨光谱输入的能感知-可知性的VIT. 我们用双线插图将瓦片的大小调整为224×224 2.24\times 224, 与本地的预训设置相匹配; 如果补丁大小为16, 窗口大小为128, 则每个瓦片产生14×14 14\tims 14个令牌网格。 它是一个单一的图像编码器,没有时间轴,所以我们把2019年的12个月的镶嵌图逐一编码,独立地将结果平均集合. - 奥尔莫地表 v1.3 [16]. OlmoEarth v1.3是专门为嵌入而建造的OlmoEarth模型. 它是一个d = 768 d = 768 编码器,有一个蒸馏的线性学生,我们读出它有三种方式——通过蒸馏的64-维和128-维的投影,在全寄存器宽度上没有投影——在整个过程中作为单独的一行报告. 使用补丁尺寸1个,窗口尺寸16个,2019年使用12个月度镶嵌来作为输入.

We use a window size of 128 and patch size of 16 for Copernicus-FM, a window size of 64 and patch size of 4 for OlmoEarth v1.2, Galileo, and AnySat and a window size of 16 and patch size of 1 for the pixelwise models, Presto and Tessera v1. The same inputs are used for fine-tuning as described for linear probes.
blocks.zh: AnySat, Galileo, Presto, Tessera v1, 哥白尼-FM [1, 14, 13, 4, 17]. 我们还评估调整这些基础模型的绩效。 哥白尼-FM的窗口尺寸为128个,补丁尺寸为16个;OlmoEarth v1.2,伽利略和AnySat的窗口尺寸为64个,补丁尺寸为4个;像素型号的窗口尺寸为16个,补丁尺寸为1个;Presto和Tesera v1. 线性探测器的微调使用相同的输入.

blocks.en: OlmoEarth v1.2 [ 15 ] . OlmoEarth v1.2 is an update of the original OlmoEarth model [ 9 ] . We fine-tune the model with patch size 4 and window size 64 (unless otherwise stated) for 50 epochs, with the backbone frozen for the first 10 epochs, at 10 − 4 10^{-4} with batch size 8. We fine-tune OlmoEarth v1.2 deliberately: v1.2 is the better fine-tuning target, whereas we released v1.3 as an embeddings-specific model.
blocks.zh: OlmoEarth v1.2 [15] (英语). OlmoEarth v1.2是原OlmoEarth模型的更新 [9]. 我们为50个纪元对模型进行微调,以补丁大小4和窗口大小64(除非另有说明),骨干为前10个纪元被冻结,为10 - 4 10 - 4 8. 联合国 我们故意微调了OlmoEarth v1.2:v1.2是更好的微调目标,而我们作为嵌入特异性模型发布了v1.3.

blocks.en: 3.2 Protocols
blocks.zh: 3.2 议定书

blocks.en: Each protocol isolates a different axis of difficulty.
blocks.zh: 每个协议隔离出不同的难度轴.

blocks.en: • In-domain (443-window test split). Train and test on splits of all six territories within PLANTEUR, except Saint-Martin which is only in the train split. Measures achievable accuracy when labels exist for the target region. • Balanced In-domain. Train on a subset of the in-domain train split, where the number of Background samples equals the total number of crop samples, to reduce the class imbalance challenge. Test on the in-domain test split. This is a less practical setting than the in-domain split, but allows comparing the effectiveness of different satellite image encoders. • Leave-one-island-out (LOIO). Train on four territories, test on the fifth. Measures transfer to a region absent from training. • Few-shot. Train on X X labeled pixels per PLANTEUR class, X ∈ { 10 , 25 , 100 , 1000 } X\in\{10,25,100,1000\} , and evaluate on the PLANTEUR test split. Measures performance given a small number of in-domain labels. • Few-shot transfer. Train on some number of PASTIS samples plus X X labeled pixels per PLANTEUR class, X ∈ { 10 , 25 , 100 , 1000 } X\in\{10,25,100,1000\} , and evaluate on the PLANTEUR test split. We experiment with using 1) all PASTIS , which uses all PASTIS samples and adds X X PLANTEUR pixels per class, and 2) balanced , which draws X X pixels of every class from both PASTIS and PLANTEUR, including overlapping classes. Measures how far a small number of local labels closes the gap left by cross-region transfer.
blocks.zh: • 域内(443-窗口测试分拆)。 PLANTEUR内部所有6个领地的分块的列车和测试,但仅列车分块的圣马丁除外. 如果目标区域有标签,衡量可实现的准确性。 • 平衡内域。 列车在域内列车分出的一个子集上,其中背景样品数量等于作物样品总数,以减少阶级不平衡的挑战. 内域测试分拆测试. 与域内分解相比,这是一个不太实际的设置,但允许比较不同卫星图像编码器的有效性. • 离岛(LOIO)。 火车在四个地区,测试在第五。 措施转移到未接受培训的地区。 • 几发. X X 标记为像素的列车,每班PLANTEUR, X {{ 10, 25, 100, 1000}} X\in 10 25, 1000 \}, 并评价 PLANTEUR 测试分. 计量绩效给少数域内标签。 • 少发子弹。 训练一些PASTIS样本,加上X X标记的像素/PLANTEUR级,X {{{10,25,100,1000}}}X\in 10 25 100 1100},并评价PLANTEUR测试分. 我们实验使用 1)所有 PASTIS ,它使用所有的 PASTIS 样本,并且每类增加 X PLANTEUR 像素; 2) 平衡,它从 PASTIS 和 PLANTEUR 中抽取每类的 X X 像素,包括相重叠的类. 衡量少数地方标签在多大程度上弥合了跨区域转让留下的差距。

blocks.en: In-domain (443-window test split). Train and test on splits of all six territories within PLANTEUR, except Saint-Martin which is only in the train split. Measures achievable accuracy when labels exist for the target region.
blocks.zh: 域内(443-窗口测试分出). PLANTEUR内部所有6个领地的分块的列车和测试,但仅列车分块的圣马丁除外. 如果目标区域有标签,衡量可实现的准确性。

blocks.en: Balanced In-domain. Train on a subset of the in-domain train split, where the number of Background samples equals the total number of crop samples, to reduce the class imbalance challenge. Test on the in-domain test split. This is a less practical setting than the in-domain split, but allows comparing the effectiveness of different satellite image encoders.
blocks.zh: 平衡内域. 在域内列车分出的一个子集上的列车,其中背景样品数量等于作物样品总数,以减少阶级不平衡的挑战. 内域测试分拆测试. 与域内分解相比,这是一个不太实际的设置,但允许比较不同卫星图像编码器的有效性.

blocks.en: Leave-one-island-out (LOIO). Train on four territories, test on the fifth. Measures transfer to a region absent from training.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-10-21) (英语). Leave-One-sport-out (LOIO). 火车在四个地区,测试在第五。 措施转移到未接受培训的地区。

blocks.en: Few-shot. Train on X X labeled pixels per PLANTEUR class, X ∈ { 10 , 25 , 100 , 1000 } X\in\{10,25,100,1000\} , and evaluate on the PLANTEUR test split. Measures performance given a small number of in-domain labels.
blocks.zh: 几发. X X 标记像素每PLANTEUR级的列车,X {{ 10, 25, 100, 1000}} X\in { 10, 25, 1000} 并评价 PLANTEUR 测试分出. 计量绩效给少数域内标签。

blocks.en: Few-shot transfer. Train on some number of PASTIS samples plus X X labeled pixels per PLANTEUR class, X ∈ { 10 , 25 , 100 , 1000 } X\in\{10,25,100,1000\} , and evaluate on the PLANTEUR test split. We experiment with using 1) all PASTIS , which uses all PASTIS samples and adds X X PLANTEUR pixels per class, and 2) balanced , which draws X X pixels of every class from both PASTIS and PLANTEUR, including overlapping classes. Measures how far a small number of local labels closes the gap left by cross-region transfer.
blocks.zh: 几发相转. 训练一些PASTIS样本,加上X X标记的像素/PLANTEUR级,X {{{10,25,100,1000}}}X\in 10 25 100 1100},并评价PLANTEUR测试分. 我们实验使用 1)所有 PASTIS ,它使用所有的 PASTIS 样本,并且每类增加 X PLANTEUR 像素; 2) 平衡,它从 PASTIS 和 PLANTEUR 中抽取每类的 X X 像素,包括相重叠的类. 衡量少数地方标签在多大程度上弥合了跨区域转让留下的差距。

blocks.en: All evaluation uses mIoU over the eight scored classes (mIoU-8); void is excluded from both the loss and the metric. For folds where a class is absent from the ground truth, we include it in the mean with IoU set to 0 to keep results comparable across territories. Overall pixel accuracy is reported alongside, but this metric can be deceiving due to the Background class being the majority class.
blocks.zh: 所有评价在8个得分等级(mIoU-8)上都使用mIoU;空值从损失和度量中排除出. 如果一个阶级没有真正存在,我们把它列入IoU设定为0的平分中,以使结果在各地区之间具有可比性。 总体像素精度被同时报告,但由于背景类是多数类,因此这个度量可能被欺骗.

blocks.en: 3.3 In-domain results (443-window test split)
blocks.zh: 3.3 域内结果(443-窗口测试分裂)

blocks.en: Table 2 reports results on the PLANTEUR 443-window test split. Fine-tuning OlmoEarth v1.2 is strongest at 40.82 40.82 mIoU, ahead of both supervised baselines (TSViT 36.33 36.33 , U-TAE 35.82 35.82 ). Among frozen encoders of comparable embedding dimensionality, OlmoEarth v1.3 (128d) is best, followed by Tessera v2 (36.88 vs. 34.20, 2.7 points).
blocks.zh: 表2报告了PLANTEUR 443窗的分拆情况。 微调 OlmoEarth v1.2 最强值为40.82 40.82 mIoU,领先于两个被监督的基线(TSViT 36.33 36.33 ;U-TAE 35.82 35.82 .). 在可比较嵌入维度的被冻结编码器中,OlmoEarth v1.3(128d)是最好的,其次是Tesera v2(36.88对34.20,2.7分).

blocks.en: Table 2: Results on the PLANTEUR 443-window test split. Best within each block in bold, best overall highlighted.
blocks.zh: 表2:PLANTEUR 443-窗口测试分拆的结果。 每个区块内最好用粗体表示,最突出的整体。

blocks.en: We evaluate both models that input monthly mosaics (e.g. Galileo, OlmoEarth) and models that input all observations (e.g. AnySat, Tessera). These models cannot be compared apples-to-apples due to compute cost, so we plot performance as a function of the compute cost in Figure 4 . This shows that OlmoEarth v1.2 is the best model at a reasonable cost, compared to AnySat and Tessera v1 which have lower performance and a higher compute cost.
blocks.zh: 我们评价输入每月镶嵌图的模型(如伽利略,奥尔莫地表)和输入所有观测的模型(如AnySat,Tesera). 由于计算成本的原因,这些模型无法将苹果与苹果相比较,所以我们绘制性能作为图4中计算成本的一个函数. 这表明OlmoEarth v1.2是价格合理的最佳模型,与AnySat和Tesera v1相比性能较低,计算成本也较高.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : MACs vs. mIoU on PLANTEUR standard test set, separated into two plots for linear probe and supervised methods. The reported MACs represent compute cost of forward pass, so released embedding products wouldn’t bear this cost. The dotted line marks AEF, a closed-weight embedding product for which encoder MACs are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 图4:PLANTEUR标准测试集上的MACs vs. mIoU,分离成两个地块进行线性探测并监督方法. 所报道的MAC是远期通行证的计算费用, 被点行标记为AEF,是一种闭量嵌入产品,没有编码器MAC.

blocks.en: For the OlmoEarth variants, we experiment with varying the input modalities. Results for both OlmoEarth v1.3 probes and OlmoEarth v1.2 fine-tuning with Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat-8 input combinations are reported in Table 3 . Sentinel-1 combined with Sentinel-2 gives a slight increase (768d: +0.5, 128d: +0.2, OlmoEarth v1.2: +0.8 mIoU points), while adding Landsat-8 does not consistently help, and no combination improves the 64-dimensional embeddings.
blocks.zh: 对于奥尔莫地变体,我们用不同的输入模式进行实验. 表3报告了OlmoEarth v1.3探测器和OlmoEarth v1.2与哨兵-2、哨兵-1和Landsat-8输入组合的结果。 Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2结合,给出了稍有增加(768d:+0.5,128d:+0.2,OlmoEarth v1.2:+0.8 mIoU分数),而加入Landsat-8并不能持续帮助,没有组合能改进64维嵌入.

blocks.en: Table 3: OlmoEarth varying inputs on the 443-window PLANTEUR test split. Best input combination per row in bold.
blocks.zh: 表3: OlmoEarth对443-Window PlanTEUR试验的不同投入。 每行最佳输入组合以粗体表示.

blocks.en: Results for varying the temporal sequence length for the OlmoEarth v1.3 linear probes and OlmoEarth v1.2 fine-tuning are shown in Figure 5 . Across all three OlmoEarth v1.3 embedding dimension sizes, performance increases by 11.6–12.8 mIoU points from one to twelve monthly mosaics, with the largest jump in improvement between a sequence length of one and three.
blocks.zh: 图5显示奥尔莫地V1.3线性探测器和奥尔莫地V1.2微调的时间序列长度的变化结果。 在OllmoEarth v1.3所有嵌入维度尺寸中,性能从每月1至12分的相间相间增高了11.6至12.8分,在序列长度为一至三之间的改进中,跳跃最大.

blocks.en: We vary the window size for the frozen encoder linear probe results with all three dimensionality variants of OlmoEarth v1.3. Table 4 shows that a larger window size of 32 increases mIoU by 1.3–1.7 points over the w = 16 w=16 setting of Table 2 , for both the distilled read-outs and the full width. Fine-tuning OlmoEarth v1.2 shows the same trend (35.82 at w = 4 w=4 to 40.82 at w = 64 w=64 ).
blocks.zh: 我们改变了冷冻编码器线性探测结果的窗口尺寸,所有三种维度变体均为OlmoEarth v1.3. 表4显示,对于已分馏的读出和全宽而言,大于32个窗口大小的mIoU比表2的w=16个w=16个设置增加了1.3至1.7分. 精调"奥尔莫地"v1.2呈现出相同趋势(W=4 w=4到40.82 W=64 w=64).

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Temporal sequence-length ablation for OlmoEarth v1.3 linear probes and OlmoEarth v1.2 fine-tuning: mIoU-8 as a function of the number of monthly mosaics provided as input. Performance improves with a larger sequence length, though the rate of increase is largest between a sequence length of one and three for all methods. OlmoEarth v1.3 probes in this ablation use a fixed learning rate of 0.1 rather than a validation-selected sweep.
blocks.zh: 图5:奥尔莫地V1.3线性探测器和奥尔莫地V1.2线性探测器的时序长振动;微调:mIoU-8作为输入提供的月相马赛克数的函数. 性能以较大的序列长度来提高,虽然在所有方法的序列长度一到三之间增加率最大. 奥尔莫地V1.3探测器在这种膨胀中采用0.1的固定学习率,而不是验证所选择的扫描.

blocks.en: Table 4: Spatial-context ablation on the 443-window PLANTEUR test split. Best window size per row in bold.
blocks.zh: 表4:443-Window PlanTEUR试验分拆的空间文本。 每行最佳窗口大小以粗体表示 。

blocks.en: 3.4 Balanced In-domain
blocks.zh: 3.4 国内平衡

blocks.en: The train / validation / test split used in Section 3.3 has majority Background samples, and this class imbalance is likely the reason for models over-predicting Background. This also means that employing specialized training strategies for imbalanced datasets can provide substantial performance gains — however, this is not the focus of our benchmark. Thus, we create a class-balanced training set to better distinguish the effectiveness of different remote sensing foundation models. We use the same test set to keep the evaluation realistic.
blocks.zh: 第3.3节中使用的列车 / 验证 / 测试分拆具有多数背景样本,这种等级失衡很可能是模型超预测背景的原因. 这还意味着,对不平衡的数据集采用专门培训战略,可以产生实质性的业绩收益——然而,这不是我们基准的重点。 因此,我们创建了一个班级平衡的培训,以便更好地区分不同的遥感基础模型的有效性。 我们使用同样的一套测试,使评价切合实际。

blocks.en: Confusion matrices for models trained on both the imbalanced and balanced sets are shown in Figure 8 in the appendix. These matrices and the results in Table 5 show an improvement (but not a huge improvement) for all methods, except for U-TAE, when using the balanced train set instead of the baseline train split. There are still a lot of pixels predicted as Background rather than the ground truth crop, suggesting that the benchmark’s difficulty goes beyond class imbalance.
blocks.zh: 附录中图8显示对不平衡和均衡组合的模型进行培训的混淆矩阵。 这些矩阵和表5的结果显示,除U-TAE外,在使用平衡列车编组而不是基线列车拆分时,所有方法都有了改进(但不是巨大的改进). 仍有许多像素被预测为"背景"而非"地上真理收成",这表明基准的困难超越了阶级不平衡.

blocks.en: Table 5: Baseline vs. balanced, where the balanced setup reduces the number of Background samples to equal the total number of crop samples, evaluated on PLANTEUR 443-window test split. Best within each block in bold, best overall highlighted. The difference in performance between columns is not large, suggesting that the task difficulty is beyond dealing with class imbalance.
blocks.zh: 表5:基准与平衡,其中平衡的设置将背景样本数量减少至等于作物样本总数,在PLANTEUR 443-窗口测试分拆上进行评估。 每个区块内最好用粗体表示,最突出的整体。 各栏的性能差异并不大,说明任务难度超出了处理阶级不平衡的问题.

blocks.en: 3.5 Leave-one-island-out (LOIO)
blocks.zh: 3.5 离岛(LOIO)

blocks.en: Held-out-territory results are in Table 6 . The best mean across folds is 25.28 25.28 (OlmoEarth v1.2 fine-tuned), followed by the OlmoEarth v1.3 128-dimensional probe (24.13, 1.2 mIoU points lower).
blocks.zh: 被搁置领土的结果见表6。 最佳的跨折叠平均值为25.28 25.28 (OlmoEarth v1.2 微调),其次是OlmoEarth v1.3 128维探测器 (24.13,1.2 mIoU分更低).

blocks.en: Table 6: PLANTEUR leave-one-island-out (LOIO) results. Mean is across the 5 folds. Best within each block in bold, best overall highlighted.
blocks.zh: 表6: PlanTEUR离岛结果。 平均值是横跨五叠. 每个区块内最好用粗体表示,最突出的整体。

blocks.en: This setup is difficult for all models. Every method achieves roughly 55–65% of its in-domain performance: likely due to the crop type distribution varying widely across the different islands and some islands only having a subset of the crop classes in PLANTEUR.
blocks.zh: 这个设置对于所有模型来说都是困难的. 每一种方法都取得了大约55-65%的域内性能:可能是由于不同岛屿的作物类型分布大相径庭,一些岛屿只在PLANTEUR中有一部分作物类别。

blocks.en: Mayotte is majority Background, so results on this fold do not hold much weight. We do not throw this region out though, because a small region with very few positive samples is a realistic application. None of the reported methods have a meaningful performance on this island.
blocks.zh: 马约特占多数 背景,所以这个折叠的结果没有多少重量. 然而,我们并不将这一地区抛出,因为一个极少数阳性样本的小区域是一种现实的应用。 所报告的方法在岛上都没有有意义的表现。

blocks.en: 3.6 Few-shot: PLANTEUR labels only
blocks.zh: 3.6 几发:仅限PLANTEUR标签

blocks.en: We test few-shot learning on PLANTEUR by training on X X pixels per class, X ∈ { 10 , 25 , 100 , 1000 } X\in\{10,25,100,1000\} , and evaluating on the PLANTEUR test set, see Table 7 . For the supervised models, we use random cropping around the labeled pixels to try to minimize overfitting.
blocks.zh: 我们通过每班X X 像素、X { 10、25、100、1000} 的训练,测试在PLANTEUR上的几发学习,并评估PLANTEUR测试集,见表7。 对于被监督的模型,我们使用被标记的像素周围的随机收割来尽量降低过度配色.

blocks.en: Table 7: Few-shot on PLANTEUR labels only: train on X X labeled PLANTEUR pixels per class, evaluate on the 443-window test split. Best within each block in bold, best overall highlighted.
blocks.zh: 表7:仅限PLANTEUR标签上的几发镜头: X上标有PLANTEUR像素的列车每班,评价443-窗口测试分出. 每个区块内最好用粗体表示,最突出的整体。

blocks.en: At X = 10 X=10 , the models have just eighty labeled pixels, and there is a wide range of performance. OlmoEarth v1.3 (128d) outperforms Tessera v2 and AEF by 3.2 and 5.6 mIoU points, and the best supervised model (TSViT) by 12.1 points. With just 10 or 25 examples, the supervised models overfit and perform similarly to predicting Background everywhere. There are likely better training recipes that would improve performance for supervised models.
blocks.zh: 在X = 10 QQ10中,模型只有八十个被标记为像素,并且表现范围很广. OlmoEarth v1.3 (128d)的成绩以3.2和5.6 mIoU的分数超过了Tesera v2和AEF,最佳被监督模型(TSViT)以12.1分. 仅用10或25个例子,被监督的模型就过度适应,其性能类似于对各地背景的预测. 很可能有更好的培训方法,可以改进受监督模式的绩效。

blocks.en:
In the few-shot setting, OlmoEarth v1.2 fine-tuning and OlmoEarth v1.3 linear probes are roughly tied at small X X (22.05 vs. 21.80 at X = 10 X=10 , 22.03 vs. 21.50 at X = 25 X=25 ). OlmoEarth v1.2 leads by 1.3 points at X = 100 X=100 , and the 768d probe leads by 1.3 at X = 1000 X=1000 . Linear probing on frozen embeddings matches full fine-tuning when labels are scarce,
at a fraction of the cost.
blocks.zh:
在几发设定中,OlmoEarth v1.2微调和OlmoEarth v1.3线性探测器大致被捆绑在小X X上(22.05对21.80对X = 10 X=-10,22.03对21.50对X = 25 X=-25). OlmoEarth v1.2在X = 100 = X=100分领先1.3分,768d探测器在X = 1000 = X=1000分领先1.3分. 对被冻结的嵌入物进行线性探测 与标签稀缺时的全微调匹配
成本的一小部分。

blocks.en: 3.7 Few-shot transfer: adding PASTIS
blocks.zh: 3.7 几发转让:增加PASTIS

blocks.en: Next, we see if adding PASTIS data to the training distribution, using the same PLANTEUR budget as Section 3.6 , can narrow the remaining gap between using the whole training split and the few-shot setting. Like Section 3.6 , we apply random cropping to the supervised runs. Results for all models are shown in Figure 6 , which visualizes the results when using X X PLANTEUR pixels per class, all PASTIS , which uses all PASTIS samples and adds X X PLANTEUR pixels per class, and balanced , which draws X X pixels of every class from both PASTIS and PLANTEUR, including overlapping classes.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们看到,利用与第3.6节相同的PLANTEUR预算,在培训分配中增加PASTIS数据,是否能够缩小使用整个培训拆分和少数镜头设定之间的剩余差距。 与第3.6节一样,我们对受监督的跑道进行随机收割。 所有模型的结果如图6所示,图6可视化在每类使用X X PLANTEUR像素时,所有PASTIS. 使用所有PASTIS样本并每类增加X PLANTEUR像素,并均衡地从PASTIS和PLANTEUR中抽取每类的X X像素,包括重叠的类.

blocks.en: When the full PASTIS training set is added to the X X labeled PLANTEUR pixels per class, the PLANTEUR supervision is a tiny fraction of the training signal: at most 8 ​ X 8X pixels, against millions of labeled PASTIS pixels. The four tropical classes (sugarcane, banana, pineapple, and tropical tuber) appear only in PLANTEUR, so most models never learn to predict them at small X X , and their mIoU comes almost entirely from the classes the two datasets share. Their scores then reflect how well PASTIS-trained features happen to transfer to those shared classes rather than how many PLANTEUR labels were added, which explains the sometimes non-monotonic trends in the all PASTIS rows.
blocks.zh: 当完整的PASTIS训练集被加入X X 标注的 PLANTEUR 像素每班时,PLANTEUR监督是训练信号的一小部分:最多8 X 8X像素,对抗被标注的上百万个PASTIS像素. 四个热带分级(苏加尔干,香蕉,菠萝和热带块茎)只出现在PLANTEUR中,因此大多数模型从未学会在小X X上预测它们,它们的mIoU几乎完全来自两个数据集共享的分级. 然后,他们的分数反映了PASTIS训练过的特性转会到这些共享的类,而不是增加了多少PLANTEUR标签,这解释了PASTIS所有行中有时非模拟的趋势。

blocks.en: When there is a more equal distribution of crops between PASTIS and PLANTEUR, the tropical classes carry real weight and so performance generally rises from X = 100 X=100 to X = 1000 X=1000 , though most methods dip between X = 10 X=10 and X = 25 X=25 .
blocks.zh: 当PASTIS和PLANTEUR之间的作物分布较为平等时,热带类会承载出真正的重量,因此性能一般由X=100 100到X=1000X=1000,不过大多数方法都从X=10X=10到X=25X=25.

blocks.en: Compared to the few-shot results in Table 7 , all OlmoEarth v1.3 variants see an improvement when adding PASTIS samples in both the all PASTIS and balanced settings, with a consistent boost for most values of X X . Tessera v2 and AEF do not see the same increase; the balanced mix barely changes them, and all PASTIS lowers them ( − - 5.6 and − - 8.1 at X = 100 X=100 ).
blocks.zh: 与表7中的少数镜头结果相比,所有OlmoEarth v1.3变体在将PASTIS样本添加到所有PASTIS和均衡的环境下时都看到了改进,并且XX的大多数值都得到了一致的提升. Tessera v2和AEF没有看到同样的增加;平衡的组合几乎不会改变它们,所有PASTIS都会降低它们(-- 5.6和--8.1 at X = 100-Q-100).

blocks.en: For OlmoEarth v1.2 fine-tuning, the balanced mix helps at every X X (+1.1 to +3.4 mIoU), while all PASTIS is mixed ( − - 2.0 to +3.4), consistent with the tropical classes being swamped by PASTIS supervision.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We introduce PLANTEUR, a new crop-type mapping segmentation benchmark, meant to expand the community’s evaluations to tropical regions, while maintaining the high quality and accuracy of the ground truth labels. As the results show, this is a difficult benchmark compared to PASTIS. Results across models are not saturated, so there is room to improve. We hope the community tackles this benchmark with new ideas and methods!
blocks.zh: 我们引入了新的作物类型绘图分界基准PlanTEUR, 旨在将社区评价扩大到热带地区, 如结果所示,与PASTIS相比,这是一个困难的基准。 各种模型的结果不饱和,因此还有改进的余地。 我们希望社区用新的想法和方法来处理这一基准问题!

blocks.en: Although PLANTEUR expands data coverage to tropical crops and regions, while maintaining high accuracy in parcel boundaries and crop types, a limitation of France’s Land Parcel Identification System is completeness – participation of farmers in reporting their data to this system is only mandatory if they participate in the EU Common Agricultural Policy, so there are still many small-scale farms that don’t participate in this program and thus do not report to this system. This is evident in the original data analysis, where we had to throw out crops like coffee and vanilla because the number of samples was far too low. Also, this program combines some tropical fields into generic or vague categories (e.g., mango and lychee fields are lumped into the orchards category). There is also a chance of crop change in between seasons that is not accounted for, or differences in growing seasons (e.g., Réunion is in the southern hemisphere so the growing seasons are out of sync with the exported imagery). In future work, it is critical to source additional high quality crop labels that expand the distribution to more and more small-scale crops.
blocks.zh: 虽然PLANTEUR将数据覆盖范围扩大到了热带作物和地区,同时保持了地块边界和作物种类的高精度,但法国土地公园识别系统的一个局限性是完整性 — — 只有当农民参与欧盟共同农业政策时,他们才能参与向该系统报告数据,因此仍有许多小规模农场不参与这一方案,因此不向该系统报告。 这一点在原始数据分析中很明显,我们不得不将咖啡和香草等作物抛出,因为样品数量太少。 另外,这个方案将一些热带田地合并为通类或模糊类(例如芒果地和淋巴地被整块划入果园类). 不同季节之间也有可能发生作物变化,这些季节没有说明,或者生长季节的差异(例如,留尼汪在南半球,因此生长季节与出口图像不同步)。 在今后的工作中,关键是要增加优质作物标签,将分布扩大到越来越多的小规模作物。

blocks.en: Table 8 compares class weighting and focal loss against the default losses of Table 2 . Inverse-frequency weighting hurts every model, by 4.0–8.8 mIoU points. The other variants change the supervised baselines by at most 1.9 points: U-TAE is best with inverse-square-root weighting (35.82 → \rightarrow 36.85) and TSViT with focal loss alone (36.33 → \rightarrow 36.45). OlmoEarth v1.2 is best with inverse-square-root weighting (40.82 → \rightarrow 41.10) and loses 0.6–7.7 points under every other alternative. The exception is the OlmoEarth v1.3 (768d) linear probe, which gains 2.5 points (38.94 → \rightarrow 41.43) with inverse-square-root weighting. Because no single loss helps consistently, we keep the default losses for all models.

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Unseen Region Transfer
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 不明区域转让

blocks.en: As the proposed benchmark is a regional extension of an existing one, it is interesting to ask whether there can be transfer between the two. We fine-tune OlmoEarth v1.3 and OlmoEarth v1.2 on PASTIS, then fit a linear probe on PLANTEUR and evaluate on the PLANTEUR test split. There are four overlapping classes between PASTIS and PLANTEUR and thus four unseen (aside from training the linear probe) classes introduced in PLANTEUR. The results, shown in Table 10 , are not impressive, which is why we emphasize the positive results of few-shot transfer, as discussed in Section 3.7 , where adding just a few examples of your region of interest to a much larger data source, can result in strong performance.
blocks.zh: 由于拟议基准是现有基准的区域延伸,因此,令人感兴趣的是,能否在两者之间转让。 我们在PATIS上微调了OlmoEarth v1.3和OlmoEarth v1.2,然后在PLANTEUR上安装了线性探测器并评估了PLANTEUR测试分解. PASTIS和PLANTEUR之间有四个相互重叠的班级,因此,除了培训PLANTEUR引入的线性探测器之外,还有四个看不见的班级。 表10显示的结果并不令人印象深刻,这就是为什么我们强调少数镜头传输的积极结果,正如第3.7节所讨论,在其中只增加几个例子,说明你所在区域感兴趣的更大数据来源,可以产生强劲的业绩。
